title: 7 Best Tweets From Jim Cramer That Will Help You Trade the Market Correction
text:
Welcome back, bulls.
With Monday's strong showing, stocks notched their first two-day winning streak in February. The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 410 points, or 1.71%, to 24,601. The S&P 500 gained 1.39% on Monday and the Nasdaq jumped 1.56%, following the session on Feb. 9, that saw wild market swings driven by worries related to faster inflation and a rise in interest rates.
Not everyone on Wall Street is convinced on the bull market being alive and well .
"The market usually cheapens up a lot in these corrections -- the problem is that it hasn't cheapened up enough," said long-time market strategist David Rosenberg at Gluskin Sheff.
Even still, it's encouraging to see the market's solid bounce on Monday. TheStreet's founder Jim Cramer has been crushing it on Twitter throughout the day, dropping key tweets on tech darlings Nvidia ( NVDA ) , Apple ( AAPL ) and Facebook ( FB ) .
